text.villager_reroller.config.title: Villager Reroller
text.villager_reroller.config.intro: Open a villager and press the book button at the top right of the trade screen. Pick one or more offers, then Start. The reroll breaks the job block. If the server has Trade Cycling, the panel can use that mod instead.
text.villager_reroller.method.unsupporte: This server does not have Trade Cycling
text.villager_reroller.hall.title: Trading hall
text.villager_reroller.hall.hint: Stays put. Skips locked villagers and job sites out of reach.
text.villager_reroller.hall.empty: Queue a villager from the trade screen.
text.villager_reroller.panel.title: %s trades
text.villager_reroller.locked: This villager has already been traded with, so the offers are locked
text.villager_reroller.no_job_site: No job site block was found next to this villager
text.villager_reroller.out_of_reach: Move closer to the job site block
text.villager_reroller.need_block: Put the job site block in your inventory first
text.villager_reroller.need_tool: You need a tool that can break the job site block
text.villager_reroller.tool_worn: Stopped because no tool has more durability left than the configured floor
text.villager_reroller.timeout: Stopped because the villager did not refresh in time
text.villager_reroller.no_profession: This villager has no profession to reroll
text.villager_reroller.need_target: Choose a trade in the list first
text.villager_reroller.config.enabled.to: When this is off, the keybind will not start a reroll.
text.villager_reroller.config.match_soun: Play an experience-orb chime when a chosen offer appears. The chat line and toast still show.
text.villager_reroller.config.match_volu: How loud the match chime is. 0 is silent. 100 is full volume.
Use an empty hand when every suitable tool is at or below the durability floor and the block does not need a tool.
text.villager_reroller.config.durability: Skip a tool when this many uses, or fewer, are left. Default is 10. Unbreakable tools are always kept.
text.villager_reroller.config.server_fri: On uses a slower cycle, longer timeouts, and a slower camera. Off restores the normal pace.
text.villager_reroller.config.ticks_betw: How long to wait between Trade Cycling requests. Normal is 8. The server-friendly preset uses 20.
text.villager_reroller.config.timeout_mu: Scales every break, place, and trade-screen timeout. Normal is 1. The server-friendly preset uses 2.
text.villager_reroller.config.look_speed: Maximum camera turn per tick. Normal is 30. The server-friendly preset uses 8.
text.villager_reroller.config.max_attemp: Stop after this many rerolls. Default is 500.
text.villager_reroller.config.panic.tool: Turn this on and save to stop automation immediately. It is not remembered.
text.villager_reroller.gui_closed: Stopped because the trade screen closed
text.villager_reroller.disabled: Automation is disabled in the config
text.villager_reroller.cannot_cycle: Stopped because this villager has already been traded with
text.villager_reroller.no_offers: Stopped because the villager has no trades yet
text.villager_reroller.permission: You do not have permission to reroll on this server
text.villager_reroller.cost: You cannot pay this server's reroll cost
text.villager_reroller.too_far: That villager is too far away
text.villager_reroller.not_trading: Open that villager's trade screen first
text.villager_reroller.server_unsupporte: This server does not have Trade Cycling, so the cycle packet was not sent
text.villager_reroller.need_screen: Open a villager trade screen first
text.villager_reroller.checklist.title: My villagers
text.villager_reroller.checklist.still_n: ! STILL NEEDED — %s missing from your wanted trades
text.villager_reroller.checklist.empty.s: 1. Trade once with any villager to lock in their offers.
2. Name, position & book levels are saved automatically.
3. Pick wanted trades in Trade Picker to track missing books.
text.villager_reroller.checklist.showing: Showing %s–%s of %s locked · Scroll for more
text.villager_reroller.checklist.tip: Tip: Press V anytime to open My villagers
text.villager_reroller.checklist.all_loc: ✓ All %s wanted trades are locked in within your target emerald prices
